outcome_class_rationale: All 3 agencies downgraded simultaneously in March 2017 (Moody's -1, S&P -2, Fitch -1). Pre-merger credit collapse. Resolved via March 2018 acquisition by Ascension — bondholder outcome was favorable (parent uplift) but standalone credit DEFINITIVELY deteriorated before M&A rescue.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: Revenue figure $2.58B is from 2014; 2016 likely similar scale. Interim 5-month 2016 showed $26.4M operating loss / 4.6% EBITDA margin. Days cash deteriorated significantly. $970M Series 2016C bond refunding planned.

ma_events_2017_2018._note: Letter of intent signed August 2017; reflects distressed-credit forced consolidation
Closed March 2018. Presence ceased to exist as standalone obligor. 12 hospitals + 150 locations rolled into AMITA Health (Ascension JV).

_research_notes: DISTRESS PATTERN: chronic operating losses + balance sheet erosion -> multi-agency simultaneous downgrade -> distressed M&A rescue. The 2016 starting position should have screened this credit as high-risk: Negative outlook from all 3 agencies, operating losses, weak cash. Strong test of any predictive model.
